faq.q1: What's the difference between web design and web development?
faq.a1: Web design covers the visual layout, UX, and brand identity of your site. Web development is the code that builds it. We handle both, or just design if you already have a development team to implement it.
faq.q2: Do you provide the Figma/design files, or just the finished website?
faq.a2: You get both — full editable design files plus the finished, responsive, live website. Nothing is locked away.
faq.q3: How many design revisions are included?
faq.a3: Our standard process includes two full revision rounds after the initial concept, with additional rounds available if your project scope changes.
faq.q4: Will the design work with WordPress or a custom build?
faq.a4: Yes — we design platform-agnostic, then hand off to our WordPress or custom development team (or yours) for implementation.
